churches.assessment: Bridge Church Fredericksburg has one of the cleanest statements of faith among the churches surveyed: Trinitarian, Bible as final authority, salvation by grace through faith, baptism as response (not requirement), Great Commission-focused. The church was launched in 2019 by Max Lucado and the Oak Hills Church (San Antonio) team — Jimmy Pruitt was the former campus pastor who was invited by Max to take it independent. That's a vote of confidence from one of the most respected evangelical communicators of our generation. The two-service Sunday model with sermon notes and discipleship resources indicates a substantive ministry rather than a casual social gathering. Main watch items: no explicit complementarian statement, no formal denominational accountability, no confirmed men's ministry. The 'inter-denominational' description means Moop would need to probe the gender/leadership question directly before committing. Overall one of the more theologically promising independent churches in the FXBG area.
